b) Reference cue: the food pieces are roughly 2-3 cm each (potato chunks about 3 cm, carrot slices about 2.5-3 cm). The plate spans roughly 7-8 of these lengths across the width of about 22-24 cm. Consistent with the type cue.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: No clear base layer under the items; the plate surface is visible. No additional hidden items counted.
